entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 2388463203438164096: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 10.4790 +/- 0.0324 mas (same row, RUWE 1.01): 95.43 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -96.719, 51.050 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 2.943 +/- 0.064 solar radii from Huber et al. 2019, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HD 221416 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....157..245H/abstract). Mass 1.212 +/- 0.074 solar masses from Huber et al. 2019, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HD 221416 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....157..245H/abstract). Temperature 5080 +/- 90 K from Huber et al. 2019, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 221416 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 5,080 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: HD 221416 is not in the library; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffe7d3. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: HD 221416 is not in the library; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,080 K and log g 3.58 (u1 0.619, u2 0.152): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
